title: Isaac Teleop SO-101 Simulation Pilot Starter
inputDevice: XR controller or SO-101 leader, depending on task
prerequisites: Install Isaac Lab using NVIDIA's current official instructions
Install/build the Isaac Teleop components required by the chosen input device
Use the current official task id matching the input device
Run only in simulation for this starter curriculum

modules.title: Simulation preflight
modules.goal: Launch the correct simulation task and confirm input, visualization and reset behavior before recording.
passCriteria: operator can reset without corrupting the session

modules.title: Basic control
modules.goal: Demonstrate bounded end-effector/gripper control without recording a scored episode.

modules.title: Record first ten demonstrations
modules.goal: Record ten task demonstrations using the official demonstration-recording path.

modules.title: Failure and recovery review
modules.goal: Review failed episodes and identify repeatable failure categories instead of deleting them.
evidenceRequired: at least one reviewed failed episode if failures occurred
passCriteria: failures are preserved or explicitly documented
operator can explain at least one improvement for the next session

modules.title: Repeatability block
modules.goal: Run a second session and compare completion, failure and reset consistency.
